sections.Profile:
On Arrakis, the player fights alongside the Fremen and House Atreides against the Harkonnen army, surviving the desert planet and harnessing its power through a cycle of day and night, in this licensed game based on the Academy Award-winning Dune film franchise. David Van Es and Travis Moseman designed it around a magnetic sandworm mech that captures and swallows the ball.
